name: bunq-banking-mcp
description: bunq banking MCP and evidence-based subscription and finance workflows.

interface.longDescription: Read bunq accounts and reconcile bank transactions, billing emails, subscriptions, fees and refunds with explicit source coverage. Includes controlled nonfinancial operations. Requires a local Python runtime and a 1Password-backed bunq API context.
defaultPrompt: Audit my subscriptions using bank records and billing emails.
Reconcile my spending, income, transfers and refunds.
Show my bunq accounts and balances.
